verdict.rationale: Coinbase Payments is API-first. Its core payment flows are documented as API, SDK or CLI operations: checkout creation, auth/capture/void, deposit destinations, transfers and payouts. The CDP CLI also ships an MCP server that exposes every API endpoint as a tool. However, nothing documents parity with the UI, and API key and wallet-secret setup is described as happening in the Coinbase Developer Portal, so at least some account setup appears to be UI-dependent; no public OpenAPI spec was found either. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, programmatic API key and account provisioning, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of full parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The CDP CLI includes an MCP server (`cdp mcp`) that exposes every API endpoint as a tool.
